RCT comparing three educational resources (leaflet, video, evidence-based booklet) for PSA screening decisions.
RCT comparing a patient decision aid to usual care for vascular access decisions in coronary angiography.
Cluster RCT comparing a patient decision aid (booklet+audiotape) to usual care for antithrombotic therapy.
RCT comparing a decision aid to a pamphlet for labour analgesia decisions.
RCT comparing a computerized risk assessment tool with tailored messages to control for cancer screening decisions.
Pilot RCT comparing a computerized decision aid to usual care for CHD prevention decisions.
Compares two pharmacological treatments (buprenorphine vs methadone). Not a decision aid trial.
RCT comparing triage methods, including an informed choice arm supported by a decision aid.
Cross-cultural validation study of a measurement scale. Not an RCT of a decision aid.
RCT comparing an interactive multimedia program to a brochure for preconsultation education on breast cancer treatment.
RCT comparing a take-home decision aid booklet to a standard information booklet for breast cancer surgery.
Pilot study evaluating decision aids vs historical control. Conservative inclusion pending full trial data.
RCT comparing a cognitive-behavioral decision aid program to control for substance use decisions in teen cancer survivors.
RCT comparing an educational intervention program to control for breastfeeding decisions.
Review/commentary on decision-making research implications. Not a primary RCT.
RCT comparing a brief patient decision aid to control for PSA testing decisions.
Cluster RCT evaluating GP training + patient empowerment leaflets vs control for antibiotic prescription decisions.
Psychometric validation study of a measurement scale. Not an RCT of a decision aid.
RCT evaluating a computer-assisted CBT program for depression. Not a decision aid for treatment/screening choices.
RCT comparing different information reminders (benefits vs benefits+risks vs simple) for cervical cancer screening decisions.
Experimental study on graphical display methods for probability. Not a clinical decision aid trial.
RCT comparing a decision aid (booklet+audio-CD) to usual care for breech presentation management decisions.
RCT comparing a CD-ROM decision aid + feedback checklist to standard care for genetic counseling/decisions.
Qualitative/preference study derived from an RCT. Does not report RCT outcomes for a DA intervention.

This is a published RCT comparing tailored patient education interventions (decision aids providing personalized information) to a general practitioner letter that modeled usual care. The study meets inclusion criteria as it compares a decision aid to usual care.

This is a cluster RCT comparing a parent-centred multi-component intervention (balanced information, group discussion, coaching exercise) designed to support informed decision-making to a leaflet-only control. The intervention functions as a decision aid compared to usual care/minimal intervention.
This is a cluster RCT explicitly comparing a 24-page decision aid booklet (designed using Ottawa Decision Framework) to a pamphlet (existing resource/usual care). Meets all inclusion criteria.
This is an RCT comparing individualized decision analysis (a decision aid) to general information and no contact controls. The decision aid intervention is compared to usual care/no intervention.

This study examines health information styles segmentation within an existing intervention rather than being a primary RCT comparing decision aids to usual care. It is a secondary/subgroup analysis of an intervention, not a comparative trial.
This is an RCT comparing a decision aid intervention to a control group (no decision aid) for menopausal symptom management. Meets inclusion criteria.

This RCT compares two versions of a decision aid: structured information only versus structured information plus values clarification exercises. Both arms receive a decision aid, making this a comparison of detailed versus simple decision aids, which is excluded per the protocol update.
This is an RCT comparing an intervention consisting of an informational pamphlet and discussion (decision aid) to treatment as usual for end-of-life decision making. Meets inclusion criteria.

This RCT compares two informational leaflets (old vs new version) with different factual content. Neither arm constitutes a decision aid - both are passive information leaflets. The study concludes 'the leaflet was not seen as an aid to decision-making.' Does not meet inclusion criteria.
This is an RCT comparing a decision aid (educational video, targeted brochure, and chart marker) to a control video about automobile safety. The decision aid is compared to usual care/control.
This is a development and acceptability study of a decision support tool, not a randomized controlled trial. There is no comparative trial design mentioned in the abstract.

This RCT compares a full PtDA (containing information and values guidance) to an abridged PtDA (containing information only). Both arms receive a decision aid, making this a comparison of detailed versus simple decision aids, which is excluded per the protocol update.
This is a subanalysis of studies included in a Cochrane systematic review, not a primary randomized controlled trial. Does not meet inclusion criteria.
This is a pilot trial without randomization - it measures knowledge before and after the intervention in a single group. Not a randomized controlled trial comparing decision aids to usual care.

This is an RCT comparing a question prompt sheet (QPS) plus hospital introduction sheet to hospital introduction sheet only. The QPS functions as a decision aid facilitating patient involvement in treatment decisions.
This is an RCT comparing personalized risk communication (a decision aid providing individualized risk information) to standard risk factor education. Meets inclusion criteria.
This is an RCT comparing an online education resource (decision aid) augmenting informed consent to standard discussion with treating surgeon. Meets inclusion criteria.
This is an analysis of decision support technologies used in studies included in a Cochrane systematic review, not a primary randomized controlled trial. Does not meet inclusion criteria.
This is an RCT comparing an interactive video program plus booklet (decision aid) to booklet alone for informing patients about back surgery treatment choices. Meets inclusion criteria.
This is a discussion paper combining personal observation with literature findings, not a randomized controlled trial. Does not meet inclusion criteria.

This is a double-blind RCT comparing a tailored decision support system (providing individualized survival and cancer incidence curves) to control for women with BRCA1/2 mutations facing cancer risk management decisions. Meets inclusion criteria.
This is an RCT comparing a decision aid intervention to control for women with suspected breast cancer. Meets inclusion criteria.
